Follow-up on typed conditions, Jack Heart: "and be like MatchConfig or something". Rename the field to config: Seating.config / match.config is the author's own Pydantic type (their class e.g. MatchConfig, like a training config; Etude defines no such class). Old stored "conditions" stays readable; keys unchanged for equal values; warning alias for the old keyword until 0.5.
